definitions.explanation: The introductory section of a document, law, or constitution that explains its purpose and principles. Also used more generally for any introductory text placed before the main body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前文|ぜんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: To read the preamble of the constitution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前文|ぜんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記|しる}されている→記す：14238_shirusu⟧。
examples.english: The purpose is stated in the preamble of the contract.

examples.japanese: {日本国|にほんこく}⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前文|ぜんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{平和主義|へいわしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理念|りねん}→理念：06027_rinen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲|かか}げられている→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
examples.english: The preamble of the Japanese constitution sets forth the principle of pacifism.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the context of constitutions, laws, treaties, and formal contracts, where the preamble establishes the document's purpose, principles, and intent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前文|ぜんぶん}: preamble of a constitution
- ⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前文|ぜんぶん}: preamble of a treaty
- {前文|ぜんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to state in the preamble

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{序文|じょぶん}→序文：06205_jobun⟧: preface, foreword — used for books and literary works; written by the author or a third party
- ⟦{序論|じょろん}→序論：23169_joron⟧: introduction — the opening section of an academic paper or essay
- ⟦{全文|ぜんぶん}→全文：11672_zenbun⟧: full text — a homophone with a completely different meaning; uses ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (whole) instead of ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before)

USAGE:
Be careful not to confuse {前文|ぜんぶん} (preamble) with the homophone ⟦{全文|ぜんぶん}→全文：11672_zenbun⟧ (full text). Context usually makes the distinction clear.
